versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.1 — First release as a LinkedIn job scraper skill.

- Added CLI and Python module for scraping public LinkedIn job postings (no authentication required).
- Supports keyword, location, remote, experience, job type, posting date, salary, and company/industry filters.
- Fetches quick job listings (title, company, location, URL, job_id) and detailed info on demand.
- Includes request throttling, UA rotation, and usage guidelines to avoid rate limiting.
- Returns data as Python dicts, JSON, or CSV.
- Provides usage examples and documentation for setup and best practices.

picoclaw-finance 1.1.0 adds support for custom categories, weekly reports, data export, and enhances PDF import.

- Added custom income/expense categories (create, remove, list via chat).
- Included weekly report summaries with comparison to previous week.
- Added CSV export for all transactions and financial data.
- Improved PDF import: detects bank format and uses specific patterns for parsing.
- Expanded default categories for more detailed classification (e.g., investimentos, impostos, pet).
- Updated expense category inference to support more keywords and new categories.

picoclaw-finance v1.0.0

- Initial release with full-featured personal finance tracking for PicoClaw via Telegram.
- Track expenses, income, and savings goals; set budgets and recurring bills.
- Import transactions from bank statement PDFs using pdftotext.
- Provides detailed monthly summaries, category breakdowns, and progress bars for goals—all formatted elegantly for Telegram.
- Data stored in JSON files under workspace/finance/ for easy backup and portability.
